contracts.output_contract: Single fenced text prompt passing scripts/lint_implement_prompt.py with zero errors, pointer-driven task graph, explicit branch-vs-worktree isolation choice, split atomic commits with clean working tree check, commit-SHA-linked issue closure, and base-branch-aware delivery/cleanup/sync protocol (dev-merge, main-pr, or branch-only).
contracts.authority_boundary: Read-only reconnaissance plus prompt compilation and lint only; never edits target product code, switches branches, creates worktrees, commits, merges, pushes, opens PRs, or closes issues in the compiling session.
